''See also: [[Dream of Darkness Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|The Dream of Darkness is a powerful [[technique]] located on the fifth page of [[Malice]]'s The Book of Eternal Night{{!}}Book of Eternal Night. It functions as a domain composed of shadows and nightmares, creating an environment where the darkness feels exceptionally thick and deep. Rather than being used for manual illusions, the [[technique]] is primarily utilized for mental and spiritual combat, attacking a target's heart, mind, and soul simultaneously. Practitioners use the [[technique]] to facilitate battles within a realm of terror, which can cause those caught in it to struggle with distinguishing between reality and hallucinations. Training within this [[technique]] involves building the [[willpower]] necessary to endure intense fear and nightmares. It can also be woven into physical objects, such as arrows, or expanded as a sphere of Shadow{{!}}shadow to affect those within its reach.}}
